quote_zh: 步骤a：以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲確基苯甲酸甲酯（化合物I）与三氟乙醇钠为反应底物，加入MOH或M2CO3，在反应溶剂中进行反应，获得2-氯-3-三氟乙氧甲基-4-甲確基苯甲酸（化合物II），具体化学反应式如下式（1）所示： (conditions and stoichiometry from the qualifying paragraphs: line 105 [0011] 其中，所述步骤a中，M为Li、Na、K离子中的一种。 / line 107 [0012] 三氟乙醇钠与化合物I的摩尔比为1.1-1.2:1 / line 112 [0013] MOH/M2CO3与化合物I的摩尔比为1-1.5:1 / line 114 [0014] 反应温度为0-5℃，反应时间为2-10小时 / lines 124-126 [0019] [0020] the thirteen permitted solvents and the solvent weight ratio 2-8:1)
arithmetic_check: Nothing to close. No mass, volume, mole, equivalent, purity or yield figure is stated for this step, or anywhere in this section. Every quantitative statement is a range: 1.1-1.2:1 and 1-1.5:1 molar ratios, a 2-8:1 solvent weight ratio, 0-5 C, 2-10 h. A range is not a charge, so no mass balance, no molar-mass check and no yield check is possible, and neither mass_balance_implausible nor molar_mass_inconsistent can be assessed. What CAN be checked is the formula bookkeeping of the transformation, and it supports the two-fold change recorded as one_pot: compound I is C10H10BrClO4S and compound II is C11H10ClF3O5S, so the step both replaces Br by OCH2CF3 and converts CO2CH3 to CO2H. Note for A5: the worked examples, not this section, are where arithmetic can actually be tested.
drawing_evidence: IMAGE_EXTRACT at line 98, step_id 1. Agrees with the prose on substrate, reagent and product. The span is INCOMPLETE, however, and this is the point A5 should check against the page image: it lists only one reactant and only the condition MOH/M2CO3. The p04 vision read of the same drawing lists five structures - compound I, the written formula CF3CH2ONa, compound II, and the written formulae CH3OH and NaBr - with MOH/M2CO3 above the arrow and nothing below it. So sodium trifluoroethoxide is drawn; only the machine span omits it. No reagent_written_not_drawn and no drawing_text_conflict is raised for this step.

arithmetic_check: Nothing to close, for the same reason: the only quantitative statements are the ranges 1-1.3:1, 1-3:1, 1-2:1, 2-8:1, -10 to 30 C and 0.5-12 h. No charge, no mass, no yield. Formula bookkeeping does close and is worth recording: compound II C11H10ClF3O5S plus 1,3-cyclohexanedione C6H8O2 gives C17H16ClF3O6S plus H2O, balanced on both sides, and C17H16ClF3O6S with molecular weight 440.82 is tembotrione. This is the one arithmetic in the section that can be verified, and it verifies.
